how_to_apply: The application form can be filled only in online mode on the AMU Careers Portal, https://careers.amuonline.ac.in. After submitting the form online, the printed copy must be submitted to the University Polytechnic. Applicants must follow all the instructions in the advertisement and in the User Manual available on the Careers Portal.
Fill in the application form online at https://careers.amuonline.ac.in up to 11 November 2026.

Pay the non-refundable processing fee of Rs. 500/- only in online mode on the Careers Portal. PwD candidates are exempted if they upload an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed proforma with the Application Form.
After successful online submission, take a printout of the PDF file of the Application Form on A4 size paper.
Sign it and paste a recent front-facing photograph at the designated place on the form.
Attach attested copies of all relevant documents, including the mark sheets or transcripts of all semesters.
Write the post applied for, the advertisement number and its date on the top-left side of the cover.

Submit the complete form by post to the Office of the Principal, University Polytechnic (Boys), Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh, on or before 18 November 2026 (Wednesday) by 4:00 pm. The notice also says the printed copy is to be submitted in the Office of the Principal, University Polytechnic, during office hours.

Meeting the minimum qualifications does not by itself entitle an applicant to an interview call. The University reserves the right to restrict the number of applicants called for interview to a reasonable number on the basis of Rules/Criteria or any other condition it may deem fit. It may constitute a Committee to scrutinize the applications and short-list applicants. Call letters for interview will be sent only to short-listed applicants, and no correspondence will be made with applicants who are not short-listed. The interview is scheduled for 26 November 2026 at 10:00 am at the Dean's Office, F/o Engg. & Tech. The University reserves the right to have selected applicants examined by an Internal Medical Board.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The appointment will be made as Assistant Professor (Contractual) for the academic session 2026-2027. The post is to be filled as per UGC norms. The appointment is purely on a temporary basis and is liable to termination at any time without any notice or assignment of reason. The notice does not mention the pay, allowances or any extension of the term.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of the following documents must be enclosed with the employment form for all teaching posts in the University: High School Certificate from a Recognized Board Mark-sheet and Degree of Graduation Mark-sheet and Degree of Post-Graduation Certificate of NET, JRF, SLET/SET, CSIR, etc. as the case may be M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree wherever applicable Experience Certificates wherever applicable Mark sheets/transcripts of all semesters, for scrutiny of the relevant branch (Annexure I) Disability Certificate on the prescribed proforma (Appendix-I), for PwD candidates If the self-attested copies are not enclosed, the employment application form will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in the AMU University Polytechnic Assistant Professor (Contractual) recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (01) post of Assistant Professor (Contractual) in the Electrical Engineering Section of University Polytechnic, AMU.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) post?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 11 November 2026, and the printed PDF copy must reach the Office of the Principal, University Polytechnic by 18 November 2026, 4:00 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E. / B.Tech. and an M.E. / M.Tech. in a relevant branch, with First Class or equivalent in either the B.E. / B.Tech. or the M.E. / M.Tech. The relevant branches are listed in Annexure I.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for the AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) post?
faq.answer: The non-refundable processing fee is Rs. 500/- per Application Form, payable only online on the Careers Portal. PwD candidates are exempted if they upload an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed proforma.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the AMU University Polytechnic Assistant Professor (Contractual) post?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://careers.amuonline.ac.in. Then send the signed printout with a photograph and attested documents to the Office of the Principal, University Polytechnic (Boys), with the post, advertisement number and date written on the top-left of the cover.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) post?
faq.answer: Applications may be scrutinized and short-listed by a Committee. Short-listed applicants will receive call letters for the interview on 26 November 2026 at 10:00 am at the Dean's Office, F/o Engg. & Tech.

faq.question: Q7. Is the AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is for the academic session 2026-2027, purely on a temporary basis, and is liable to termination at any time without any notice or assignment of reason.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must be enclosed with the AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) application?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of the High School Certificate, graduation and post-graduation mark sheets and degrees, and NET/JRF/SLET/SET/CSIR certificates as the case may be, plus M.Phil./Ph.D. and experience certificates wherever applicable. Mark sheets or transcripts of all semesters are also mandatory.

faq.question: Q9. Can OCI cardholders apply for the AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) post?
faq.answer: Yes. Applications are invited from Indian Nationals, including Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) Cardholders under Section 7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955.
